title: SugarCraft — SugarAsync
description: SugarAsync: Async building blocks for ReactPHP — cancellation tokens and sources, disposable subscription handles, timeout / deadline / retry / debounce / throttle / fan-in helpers, in-flight coalescing, and a TTL async cache.
ogDescription: Shared async vocabulary — CancellationToken, Subscriptions, AsyncOps helpers (withTimeout, retry, debounce, throttle). Foundation for ReactPHP usage across the ecosystem.
detailMeta: original — no 1:1 Go counterpart async cancellation reactphp foundation
